items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Siblings: of course, Bill Barron. You’ve mentioned him, and apparently Junior – William Barron, Jr.

ctx.x: My mother is from a place called Abbeville, which is – Abbeville, South Carolina, which is maybe a couple of hours from Savannah, Georgia. My father’s also from South Carolina.
We have that in common too. My father’s from South Carolina. This is wonderful. Siblings: of course, Bill Barron. You’ve mentioned him, and apparently Junior – William Barron, Jr.
